name: momentum_decay_adaptive_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP and VWAP algorithms working directional orders over 5-15 minute windows create positive autocorrelation in 5-second returns — the same institution keeps hitting the bid or ask repeatedly, producing runs of same-sign returns. When the rolling AR(1) coefficient on 5-second returns (over the prior 10 minutes) exceeds ~0.12, it signals an active directional algo is still working its order, and the current 1-minute momentum direction is likely to persist for another 30-90 seconds. We enter in the momentum direction only when AR(1) is positive and confirms persistence, and we widen stops/targets when AR(1) is high (long half-life, slow decay) versus tighter parameters when AR(1) is borderline (fast decay, quick in-out).
core_signal_oneliner: Rolling 10-minute AR(1) coefficient above threshold confirming positive return autocorrelation, with 1-minute directional momentum as the trade trigger
